verdict.rationale: The product is itself the official Python/TypeScript Agent SDK, extensively documented with install instructions (pip/npm), code samples, agent loop, tools, hooks, permissions, MCP, sessions, and production deployment guidance, plus a public GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reviews of the SDK build experience beyond vendor docs, and clarity on how recent billing-policy controversy (comm-1..8) affects long-term reliability of building on it, though this doesn't contradict the core SDK capability itself.
